roleAssessment.note: Markdown files in a repository directory act as the shared decision-history store.

modules.name: Why-pack store
modules.responsibility: Stores one shared Markdown decision pack per branch under .reasongraph/why/. The read side does not care which agent wrote the session.

evidence.note: whyDir resolves to .reasongraph/why.
Git operations are scoped to .reasongraph/why.
The installed skill directs agents to read packs from .reasongraph/why.

modules.name: Transcript adapters
modules.responsibility: Discovers sessions for the current repo and normalizes them into user_text, assistant_text, thinking, and tool_call_summary. Active tools are Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and cursor-agent. JSONL adapters keep a byte offset. OpenCode reads session_v2 and session_message and ignores a legacy session table.

evidence.note: ADAPTERS lists the four tools. STUBBED_ADAPTERS is empty.

evidence.quote: SELECT id, directory, path FROM session_v2
evidence.note: Live OpenCode schema used on this machine.
Codex JSONL is matched on session_meta cwd.

modules.name: Session state
modules.responsibility: Persists one record per session, including last_distilled_offset for JSONL and last_distilled_cursor for OpenCode. The map key is the session id shared databases need.

evidence.note: Offset stays numeric. Cursor is an optional message id.

modules.name: Session distill
modules.responsibility: Reads only the undistilled span through readNew and merges normalized events into the branch why-pack. A truncated distill does not advance either cursor.

evidence.note: The state-map key is passed as session_id.

modules.name: Settle commands
modules.responsibility: Sweep, status, and the Claude Stop hook ask the adapter whether a session grew. Codex, OpenCode, and cursor-agent have no native hooks; they settle through distill and sync.

evidence.note: Freshness is delegated to adapterFor(rec.tool).
Stop-hook growth uses unread bytes, not file size.

modules.name: Agent transcripts
modules.responsibility: Private transcripts outside the repo: Codex JSONL, OpenCode sqlite, and cursor-agent JSONL. cursor-agent store.db is not part of this store for ReasonGraph.
